summary: Purchase 25 Sentry seats (team) + SCIM/SSO provisioning for backend & infra
description:
Issue summary: Request to purchase 25 Sentry team seats (monthly plan with organization-level features) to consolidate error/observability tooling for backend and infra teams. Requestor needs automated user provisioning (SCIM) and Okta SSO integration.

Requested by: Backend Reliability & Infra leads.
Requested delivery window: within 2 weeks to cover upcoming on-call rotation.

Procurement details required: vendor quote, PO issuance, billing cadence (monthly vs annual), tax handling, and whether a short-term trial or commitment is recommended for negotiation of a multi-team discount.
business_impact: Current state: teams are on several legacy Sentry projects under different emails and personal accounts causing fragmented alerting and duplicate ownership. Impact: missed alerts and slower incident response during maintenance windows. Consolidation will reduce on-call confusion and centralize cost. This is not customer-facing outage mitigation but reduces MTTR risk and engineering toil.
seat_type: Sentry Team (monthly) with Audit/Release Tracking add-ons
sso_provider: Okta (SCIM v2 + SAML), group sync to map infra/backends/oncall groups
comments: 2026-03-04 - Maya Gonzales: Filing this to centralize Sentry usage across Backend and Infra. Estimate: 25 seats to cover primary engineers + 5 reserve seats for rotation. Prefers monthly billing for now to avoid multi-quarter commitment.

2026-03-05 - Jackson Miller (IT Proc): Thanks, Maya — can you confirm if there are existing consolidated invoices or team-owned cards? Finance needs an expected annual run rate estimate and whether we should negotiate an annual discount. Also tagging Finance.
2026-03-05 - Priya Nair (Finance): We prefer annual commit if discount >10%. Please ask vendor for monthly vs annual pricing and minimum term. Provide budget code (received).

2026-03-06 - Identity Team (Liam Chen): We'll need a SCIM provisioning plan and attribute map. Which groups should be synced (backend, infra, oncall)? Also confirm attribute mapping: email, displayName, title, manager.

2026-03-07 - Maya Gonzales: Confirm groups: infra-engineers, backend-service-owners, oncall-rotation. Confirm attributes as above. Ok with starting on monthly plan for immediate needs; will convert to annual if discount makes sense.
2026-03-08 - Jackson Miller: Received quote from vendor. Vendor quote attached in IT drive (link provided in Confluence). Preparing PO; awaiting Finance approval for charge to ENG-2026-Q1-OPS.
2026-03-09 - Priya Nair (Finance): Approved pending final invoice and confirmation of SCIM provisioning date. Move to 'In Progress'.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-05 - Inventory audit: Found 18 active Sentry seats currently spread across 3 orgs; 7 users are on personal accounts. Consolidation will require export of project data and membership reconciliation.
2026-03-06 - Contract check: No active org-wide Redwood enterprise license for Sentry. Previous purchases were team-level cards without central procurement. No existing ELA.
2026-03-06 - Technical check (Identity): Okta SCIM connector supported by Sentry; needs service account with token and group mappings. Estimated effort: 3–4 hours to configure and test in staging.
2026-03-07 - Pricing negotiation: Vendor offered 8% discount on annual commit for 25 seats; monthly pricing available without commit. Requestor prefers monthly initially.
2026-03-08 - Risk analysis: Export/migration of projects requires owner coordination. Recommend phased migration: infra first, backend second, then cross-team shared projects.
resolution: 2026-03-10 - PO issued (PO-2026-ENG-1124). Vendor acknowledged receipt and scheduled account setup. Invoice will be monthly until annual commit is requested.
2026-03-12 - Identity completed SCIM connector setup in staging and validated group sync for infra-engineers and backend-service-owners. SSO SAML configuration pending final metadata exchange.
2026-03-12 - Procurement: Central billing created; Finance will process monthly invoices to ENG-2026-Q1-OPS. Documented vendor contact and renewal calendar in Confluence.

Follow-up items: 1) Schedule migration windows with project owners; 2) Decide on annual commit by 2026-04-15 if usage stabilizes; 3) Create runbook for provisioning new seats via Okta group membership.
acceptance_criteria: PO executed and payment method confirmed
25 seats provisioned in the new central Sentry org
SCIM provisioning in production with Okta group sync operational
SSO SAML login tested for at least 3 users across backend/infra
Consolidation plan scheduled with project owners and migration windows booked
